entry.summary:
What will retirement look like in Aotearoa in the decades ahead—and are we making the right choices today to shape it? 

Every three years, the Retirement Commission is required to undertake a review of retirement income policies. Launched in November 2025, the launch provided a deep dive into how New Zealand’s retirement system is serving its people and where it needs to go next. 
 
See full Review of Retirement Income Policies report:  https://retirement.govt.nz/policy-and-research/2025-review-of-retirement-income-policies

More information on National Strategy for Financial Capability Connection Series: https://nationalstrategy.retirement.govt.nz/national-strategy/events/connection-series
